thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate (api-gateway-us). spike started ~2024-09-12T14:03Z. paging oncall-sre.
oncall-sre: seeing 502/504s, spike to ~7% 5xx at the gateway. latency for successful requests up ~2x.
ryan: I’m on it, pulling traces now. any recent deploys to runtime or kv layer?
maria: no recent runtime deploys in last 3h. but there was a config change to kv-prefetch ondedup last night (small rollout).
alex: adding logs: gateway logs show increased backend timeouts to kv-store read path, many 499s from downstream. suspect prefix-kv read latency.
oncall-sre: paging infra-eng and steph for cache/kv. steph, can you check health of prefix-shard-12/13?
steph: looking. metrics show shard-12 P50 read latency jumped from 5ms -> 180ms, error rate 4.2% 5xx. I see rapid evictions + reclaim churn around 14:01Z.
infra-eng: we’re seeing frequent checksum mismatch retransmits on the prefix cache peer ring for those shards. could be coroutine in rebalancer causing hot loop.
ryan: quick mitigation idea: route traffic away from shard-12 by adjusting routing policy to avoid pool a in us-east for 10m. can we route to fallback pool?
maria: canary routing change would be low friction. ops-bot: run `rb route set --service api-gateway --avoid-pool pool-a-us-east --duration 600s`?
ops-bot: executed: `rb route set ...` — change applied, 5% of traffic moved to pool-b (fallback).
oncall-sre: after route shift, 5xx dropped to 3.5% but still elevated vs baseline 0.2%.
ryan: also we should enable aggressive prefix cache bypass for affected keys to avoid pulling corrupted entries: `KV_PREFETCH_BYPASS=true` on gateway env for rollout.
steph: prepping a targeted cache flush for shard-12. command: ```
# flush keys with prefix pfx-12
kvctl flush --shard=12 --prefix=pfx-12 --dry-run
kvctl flush --shard=12 --prefix=pfx-12 --confirm
```
alex: before we flush, customers impacted? customer-success: any active customers complaining?
customer-success: we’ve got two enterprise alerts: AcmeCorp experiencing degraded responses in their ingestion pipeline; error rates reported ~6% for them. They called support 14:08Z.
oncall-sre: prioritizing: AcmeCorp is VIP. we need to clear hot-reads asap.
maria: rolling the bypass flag to gateways in region us-east. applied to 50% of nodes. monitor.
ops-bot: flag rollout complete to 50% nodes in us-east.
ryan: running curl check against sample prefix key path: `curl -v "https://gateway/api/v1/kv/pfx-12/somekey" -H 'x-team:ryan'`
(ryan posts snippet)
ryan: observed intermittent 504s on those calls, and occasionally `ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH` in response body.
steph: flushing shard-12 now. starting with a targeted dry-run to validate ops playbook.
steph: dry-run listed ~12k keys to evict. running confirm now.
infra-eng: during flush we see burst of backend load. please enable temporary rate limit to reduce fanout: `gateway-limiter set --route /v1/generate --rps 8000`
oncall-sre: rate limit applied. traffic dropped to avoid thrashing origin. 5xx now 1.1% and falling.
ryan: after flush and bypass, gateway 5xx back near baseline 0.25% for most customers. AcmeCorp still reporting a small error tail ~0.6%.
customer-success: AcmeCorp says errors improved after ~14:20Z but they see occasional timeouts.
maria: recommending follow-ups: 1) triage corrupted shard root cause; 2) increase KV checksum telemetry; 3) run post-incident customer impact report; 4) postmortem and rollout hold for that prefetch change.
steph: collecting logs for shard-12: `s3://redwood-logs/prefix-shard-12/2024-09-12/14/*` and saving snapshot.
infra-eng: prelim root cause: race in shard rebalancer + a corner-case in checksum verification that allowed stale entries to be served while eviction was in-flight. this created read-amplification and cascading timeouts.
oncall-sre: creating pagerduty incident and handing off to next oncall (ryan -> alex). alex, please take lead on postmortem and long-term fix.
alex: ack. I’ll own the postmortem. steps: capture timeline, config diff for prefetch rollout, shard rebalancer trace, and write mitigations (circuit-breaker on checksum errors + backoff in rebalancer).
ops-bot: created incident PD-3421. severity S2.
customer-success: I'll coordinate customer comms for AcmeCorp and send an interim update: root cause identified as prefix cache inconsistency, mitigations applied, next update in 2h.
oncall-sre: handoff notes for next oncall: watch shard-12 latency, ensure bypass flag removed only after stable 1h; follow-up task to rollback prefetch change if we see regression on next rollout.
ryan: leaving logs and CLI snippets in the incident ticket. handoff to alex now.
alex: taking over. thanks team — will prepare timeline and assign owners.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 5xx rates reduced to near baseline. active mitigations: shard flush, routing to fallback pool, prefix bypass flag, temporary rate limit. next update in 2h or on major change. :white_check_mark:
